ModMetaData.name: Fairycore - Magic Wand
ModMetaData.author: Faeris
ModMetaData.description:
Fairycore - Magic Wand adds five small wands that shape a psycaster's focus into glowing orbs, each of its own element.
THE WANDS
- Silver serpent wand (white): crackling orbs that pierce armor, burn with lightning and stun mechanoids. - Elder wand (green): burns and poisons, 5% toxic buildup per hit. - Vine wand (yellow): splashes the target with burning acid. - Holly wand (red): sets the target alight, 5% heatstroke per hit. - Ivory wand (blue): bites with frostbite, 5% hypothermia per hit.
Every orb staggers what it hits, up to the size of a muffalo.
PSYCHIC SENSITIVITY
The more psychically sensitive the caster, the fiercer the elements, up to three times as strong. The orb itself always hits the same.
FIRE MODES
A button beside the wand switches between: - Single shot: slow and steady, like a bolt-action rifle. - Burst: three quick orbs, like a heavy SMG.
The wand glows in its orb's colour as it is cast, and every orb bursts into light where it lands.
PSYCASTERS ONLY
Only a psylinked pawn can channel a wand (Vanilla Psycasts Expanded psycasters count too). In anyone else's hands it is just a stick, about as good as a wooden mace.
A favourite of the pixies of Fairycore - Spirit Wings, but any psycaster can wield one.
DETAILS
- Medieval tech: researched with Smithing and made at a smithy from wood (wood and Eltex with Vanilla Psycasts Expanded). - Not carried by NPCs; traders may stock them. - Combat Extended: supported. No ammo needed: each orb costs 1% psyfocus instead. Without CE a wand never uses psyfocus. - Royalty: needed in practice, since psylinks come from Royalty (or Vanilla Psycasts Expanded). - Requires Harmony. - Safe to add to an existing save.
CREDITS
